capabilities: Configure search scope and excluded folders
extras: No default hotkey is assigned; results initially show top 100 files with a load-more option. Indexing is local-only with no network, telemetry, or file modification. README includes author contact details and unrelated promotional links.
intentEvidence: weighted vault search and quick insertion of matching content, heading links, and block links
problem: Obsidian's built-in search cannot weight different fields or insert matching content and links through typed triggers.
summary: Weighted vault search plugin that ranks matches by per-field weights and inserts matching text, heading links, or block links.
